## File: huggingface_transformers/src/transformers/models/minimax_m2/modeling_minimax_m2.py

Prompts

```
['create a MiniMaxM2Model instance from a MiniMaxM2Config for autoregressive generation', 'run MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM to generate text from a prompt with optional labels for training', 'test MiniMaxM2SparseMoeBlock forward pass with hidden states through top-k expert routing', 'review MiniMaxM2Attention class with RMSNorm, rotary embeddings, and multi-head attention', 'summarize load_balancing_loss_func for computing auxiliary load balancing loss across experts', 'create a MiniMaxM2Config with custom vocab size, hidden size, layers, and MoE expert parameters', 'build a MiniMaxM2Model transformer with sparse MoE layers, GQA attention, and RoPE embeddings', 'build a MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM language model with top-k MoE routing and sigmoid activation', 'test the MiniMaxM2SparseMoeBlock forward pass with top-k expert selection and correction bias', 'review the MiniMaxM2TopKRouter routing logic using sigmoid activation instead of softmax']
```

```

```
